body: The wrapper stderr fix is verified (it fails without the fix), burst_denied is reset, and --capacity warns. One blocking line: tests/test_cargo_wrapper.sh:1495 is garbled ('2>build b_stderr_refuse 2>&1 ... {b80_1}>&-1 ...'). It creates a stray ./build file in the repo root on every run. Replace it with: bash "$W" build b_stderr_refuse 2>&1 >/dev/null {b80_0}>&- {b80_1}>&-). Push it with the #11 one-liner and mail me. I'll verify both deltas directly.
